name: loopStepMap_contracting
doc:
**`RealLoopModel` 的「存在性未证」闭合（第一步）**：
固定输入下隐状态映射 `h ↦ φ(W h + U x)` 满足 Banach 收缩条件。
直接由 `RealLoopModel.loop_model_contraction`（已证的 `ρ`-Lipschitz）+ 第二步得到。
stmt:
theorem loopStepMap_contracting (φ : X → X) (W U : X →L[ℝ] X) (Lφ : ℝ)
    (hφ : ∀ a b, ‖φ a - φ b‖ ≤ Lφ * ‖a - b‖) (hLφ : 0 ≤ Lφ)
    (hρ1 : Lφ * ‖W‖ < 1) (x : X) :
    ContractingWith ⟨Lφ * ‖W‖, mul_nonneg hLφ (norm_nonneg W)⟩ (loopStepMap φ W U x)
proof:
contracting_of_lipschitz (mul_nonneg hLφ (norm_nonneg W)) hρ1 _
    (loop_model_contraction φ W U Lφ hφ hLφ x)

name: loop_fixed_point_exists
doc:
**`RealLoopModel` 的「不动点存在性未证」闭合**：
完备范数空间 + ρ = Lφ·‖W‖ < 1 ⟹ 隐状态映射存在不动点。
这是 `RealLoopModel.loop_fixed_point_unique`（只给唯一性）的**存在性补全**。
stmt:
theorem loop_fixed_point_exists [CompleteSpace X] (φ : X → X) (W U : X →L[ℝ] X) (Lφ : ℝ)
    (hφ : ∀ a b, ‖φ a - φ b‖ ≤ Lφ * ‖a - b‖) (hLφ : 0 ≤ Lφ)
    (hρ1 : Lφ * ‖W‖ < 1) (x : X) :
    ∃ p : X, loopStepMap φ W U x p = p
proof:
by
  have hc := loopStepMap_contracting φ W U Lφ hφ hLφ hρ1 x
  have hfin : edist x (loopStepMap φ W U x x) ≠ ⊤ := by
    rw [edist_dist]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
  obtain ⟨p, hp, _⟩ := hc.exists_fixedPoint x hfin
  exact ⟨p, hp.eq⟩

name: loop_fixed_point_existsUnique
doc:
**存在唯一性（本文件对 `RealLoopModel` 的完整闭合）**：
存在性由 Banach 给出（需要 `CompleteSpace`），唯一性直接复用
`RealLoopModel.loop_fixed_point_unique`（不需要完备性）——两条路线在此交叉验证。
stmt:
theorem loop_fixed_point_existsUnique [CompleteSpace X] (φ : X → X) (W U : X →L[ℝ] X) (Lφ : ℝ)
    (hφ : ∀ a b, ‖φ a - φ b‖ ≤ Lφ * ‖a - b‖) (hLφ : 0 ≤ Lφ)
    (hρ1 : Lφ * ‖W‖ < 1) (x : X) :
    ∃! p : X, loopStepMap φ W U x p = p
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := loop_fixed_point_exists φ W U Lφ hφ hLφ hρ1 x
  exact ⟨p, hp, fun q hq => loop_fixed_point_unique φ W U Lφ hφ hLφ hρ1 x q p hq hp⟩

name: loop_iterate_tendsto_fixedPoint
doc:
交叉验证：Banach 路线得到的不动点与迭代极限一致——
`ContractingWith.exists_fixedPoint` 的收敛部分给出 `Tⁿ h₀ → p`，
而 `RealLoopModel.loop_converges_to_fixed_point` 给出几何误差界。
此处把两者拼成一条「迭代收敛到该不动点」的陈述（`Tendsto` 形式）。
stmt:
theorem loop_iterate_tendsto_fixedPoint [CompleteSpace X] (φ : X → X) (W U : X →L[ℝ] X) (Lφ : ℝ)
    (hφ : ∀ a b, ‖φ a - φ b‖ ≤ Lφ * ‖a - b‖) (hLφ : 0 ≤ Lφ)
    (hρ1 : Lφ * ‖W‖ < 1) (x : X) :
    ∃ p : X, loopStepMap φ W U x p = p ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (loopStepMap φ W U x)^[n] x) Filter.atTop (nhds p)
proof:
by
  have hc := loopStepMap_contracting φ W U Lφ hφ hLφ hρ1 x
  have hfin : edist x (loopStepMap φ W U x x) ≠ ⊤ := by
    rw [edist_dist]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hconv, _⟩ := hc.exists_fixedPoint x hfin
  exact ⟨p, hp.eq, hconv⟩

name: affineStep_lipschitz
doc: 仿射步的 Lipschitz 性：`‖T‖`-Lipschitz（`b` 在差中抵消）。
stmt:
theorem affineStep_lipschitz (T : X →L[ℝ] X) (b : X) :
    ∀ a c, ‖affineStep T b a - affineStep T b c‖ ≤ ‖T‖ * ‖a - c‖
proof:
by
  intro a c
  have h : affineStep T b a - affineStep T b c = T (a - c) := by
    simp only [affineStep, map_sub]
    abel
  rw [h]
  exact T.le_opNorm (a - c)

name: affineStep_contracting
doc: **`‖T‖ < 1` ⟹ 仿射步是 `‖T‖`-收缩**（`RealL2Operator` 的算子范数进入 Banach 链条）。
stmt:
theorem affineStep_contracting (T : X →L[ℝ] X) (b : X) (hT : ‖T‖ < 1) :
    ContractingWith ⟨‖T‖, norm_nonneg T⟩ (affineStep T b)
proof: contracting_of_lipschitz (norm_nonneg T) hT _ (affineStep_lipschitz T b)

name: affine_fixed_point_exists
doc:
**仿射不动点存在性**：完备范数空间 + `‖T‖ < 1` ⟹ `∃p, T p + b = p`。
这补上了 `RealL2Operator` / `RealMatrixStability` 中标注的「不动点存在性未做」
（注意：对**线性** `T` 而言不动点存在性是平凡的，见 `linearMap_fixed_point_zero`；
有价值的正是仿射版本）。
stmt:
theorem affine_fixed_point_exists [CompleteSpace X] (T : X →L[ℝ] X) (b : X) (hT : ‖T‖ < 1) :
    ∃ p : X, T p + b = p
proof:
by
  have hc := affineStep_contracting T b hT
  have hfin : edist (0 : X) (affineStep T b 0) ≠ ⊤ := by
    rw [edist_dist]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
  obtain ⟨p, hp, _⟩ := hc.exists_fixedPoint (0 : X) hfin
  exact ⟨p, hp.eq⟩

name: affine_fixed_point_unique
doc:
**仿射不动点唯一性**（不需完备性）：`‖T‖ < 1` 时 `p − q = T(p − q)` 且
`‖p − q‖ ≤ ‖T‖‖p − q‖`，由 `1 − ‖T‖ > 0` 得 `p = q`。
stmt:
theorem affine_fixed_point_unique (T : X →L[ℝ] X) (b : X) (hT : ‖T‖ < 1) {p q : X}
    (hp : T p + b = p) (hq : T q + b = q) : p = q
proof:
by
  have hfix : T (p - q) = p - q := by
    have h1 : T (p - q) = (T p + b) - (T q + b) := by
      rw [map_sub]
      abel
    rw [h1, hp, hq]
  have hnorm : ‖p - q‖ ≤ ‖T‖ * ‖p - q‖ := by
    calc ‖p - q‖ = ‖T (p - q)‖ := by rw [hfix]
      _ ≤ ‖T‖ * ‖p - q‖ := T.le_opNorm (p - q)
  have hd0 : 0 ≤ ‖p - q‖ := norm_nonneg _
  have hpos : 0 < 1 - ‖T‖ := by linarith
  have hle : (1 - ‖T‖) * ‖p - q‖ ≤ 0 := by nlinarith
  have hzero : ‖p - q‖ = 0 :=
    le_antisymm (by nlinarith) hd0
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_eq_zero.mp hzero)

name: affine_fixed_point_existsUnique
doc: **仿射不动点：存在唯一**。
stmt:
theorem affine_fixed_point_existsUnique [CompleteSpace X] (T : X →L[ℝ] X) (b : X)
    (hT : ‖T‖ < 1) : ∃! p : X, T p + b = p
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := affine_fixed_point_exists T b hT
  exact ⟨p, hp, fun q hq => affine_fixed_point_unique T b hT hq hp⟩

name: linearMap_fixed_point_zero
doc:
**线性算子的不动点存在性是平凡的**：`T 0 = 0` 对任意连续线性算子成立。
（诚实修正：`RealL2Operator` 标注的「不动点存在性未做」若指**线性**版本则无需完备性；
本文件因此只把仿射版本作为实质性缺口来闭合。）
stmt: theorem linearMap_fixed_point_zero (T : X →L[ℝ] X) : T 0 = 0
proof: map_zero T

name: affine_iterate_eq_geometric
doc:
**仿射迭代的显式公式**：`(x ↦ T x + b)` 的 n 次迭代是
`x ↦ (∑_{k<n} T^k b) + T^n x`。
stmt:
theorem affine_iterate_eq_geometric (T : X →L[ℝ] X) (b x : X) (n : ℕ) :
    (affineStep T b)^[n] x = (∑ k in Finset.range n, (T ^ k) b) + (T ^ n) x
proof:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih]
                           
      simp only [affineStep, map_add]
      rw [map_sum, Finset.sum_range_succ']
                                    
      have hshift : ∀ k : ℕ, T ((T ^ k) b) = (T ^ (k + 1)) b := by
        intro k
        rw [pow_succ']
        rfl
      simp only [hshift]
      rw [pow_succ', pow_zero, ContinuousLinearMap.one_apply]
                                         
      rw [show T ((T ^ n) x) = (T * T ^ n) x from rfl]
      abel

name: affine_fixed_point_expansion
doc:
**不动点的精确展开**：若 `T p + b = p`，则 `p = (∑_{k<n} T^k b) + T^n p`。
这是「不动点 = 几何和的极限」的有限截断形式（`T^n p → 0`）。
stmt:
theorem affine_fixed_point_expansion (T : X →L[ℝ] X) (b p : X) (hp : T p + b = p) (n : ℕ) :
    p = (∑ k in Finset.range n, (T ^ k) b) + (T ^ n) p
proof:
by
  have hpq : affineStep T b p = p := by
    simp only [affineStep]
    exact hp
  have hiter : (affineStep T b)^[n] p = p := by
    induction n with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ n ih => rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih, hpq]
                                         
  conv_lhs => rw [← hiter]
  rw [affine_iterate_eq_geometric]

name: affine_fixed_point_geometric_decay
doc:
**到几何和的距离按 `‖T‖ⁿ` 几何衰减**：`‖p − ∑_{k<n} T^k b‖ ≤ ‖T‖ⁿ‖p‖`。
这是 `RealMatrixStability` 中「`n → ∞` 收敛和未证」的可用替代形式
（极限值 `∑_{k<n} T^k b` 的误差被显式控制）。
stmt:
theorem affine_fixed_point_geometric_decay (T : X →L[ℝ] X) (b p : X) (hp : T p + b = p) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖p - ∑ k in Finset.range n, (T ^ k) b‖ ≤ ‖T‖ ^ n * ‖p‖
proof:
by
  have hexp := affine_fixed_point_expansion T b p hp n
  have hsub : p - ∑ k in Finset.range n, (T ^ k) b = (T ^ n) p := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hexp]
    abel
  rw [hsub]
  exact op_norm_pow_apply_le T n p

name: iterateStep_eq_iterate
doc:
**`RealMatrixStability.iterateStep` 就是仿射迭代**：
`iterateStep T b n = (x ↦ T x + b)^[n] 0`（两者的递归方程相同）。
这一步把 `RealMatrixStability` 的迭代累积界接进本文件的不动点框架。
stmt:
theorem iterateStep_eq_iterate (T : X →L[ℝ] X) (b : X) (n : ℕ) :
    iterateStep T b n = (affineStep T b)^[n] (0 : X)
proof:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [iterateStep_succ, ih, Function.iterate_succ_apply']
      rfl

name: iterateStep_eq_geometric
doc: **`iterateStep` 的显式几何和形式**：`iterateStep T b n = ∑_{k<n} T^k b`。
stmt:
theorem iterateStep_eq_geometric (T : X →L[ℝ] X) (b : X) (n : ℕ) :
    iterateStep T b n = ∑ k in Finset.range n, (T ^ k) b
proof:
by
  rw [iterateStep_eq_iterate, affine_iterate_eq_geometric]
  simp

name: iterateStep_dist_fixedPoint_le
doc:
**`iterateStep` 到仿射不动点的几何距离界**：
`‖iterateStep T b n − p‖ ≤ ‖T‖ⁿ‖p‖`（`p` 是任意仿射不动点）。
这给出了 `RealMatrixStability` 中 `∑_{k<n}‖T‖^k‖b‖` 之外的**收敛形式**。
stmt:
theorem iterateStep_dist_fixedPoint_le (T : X →L[ℝ] X) (b p : X) (hp : T p + b = p) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖iterateStep T b n - p‖ ≤ ‖T‖ ^ n * ‖p‖
proof:
by
  rw [iterateStep_eq_geometric]
  have h := affine_fixed_point_expansion T b p hp n
  have hsub : (∑ k in Finset.range n, (T ^ k) b) - p = -((T ^ n) p) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [h]
    abel
  rw [hsub, norm_neg]
  exact op_norm_pow_apply_le T n p

name: iterateStep_tendsto_fixedPoint
doc:
**`iterateStep` 收敛到不动点**（完备 + `‖T‖ < 1`）：
`n ↦ iterateStep T b n` 收敛到（唯一）仿射不动点。
stmt:
theorem iterateStep_tendsto_fixedPoint [CompleteSpace X] (T : X →L[ℝ] X) (b : X)
    (hT : ‖T‖ < 1) :
    ∃ p : X, T p + b = p ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => iterateStep T b n) Filter.atTop (nhds p)
proof:
by
  have hc := affineStep_contracting T b hT
  have hfin : edist (0 : X) (affineStep T b 0) ≠ ⊤ := by
    rw [edist_dist]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hconv, _⟩ := hc.exists_fixedPoint (0 : X) hfin
  refine ⟨p, hp.eq, ?_⟩
  have hfun : (fun n : ℕ => iterateStep T b n)
      = fun n : ℕ => (affineStep T b)^[n] (0 : X) := by
    funext n
    exact iterateStep_eq_iterate T b n
  rw [hfun]
  exact hconv

name: contraction_of_deriv_bound
doc:
**导数有界 ⟹ 压缩**（中值定理）：若 `f` 处处 Frechet 可导、导数 `f'` 的算子范数
一致地被 `C` 控制，则 `f` 是 `C`-Lipschitz。
用 `Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasFDerivWithin_le`（在 `univ` 上）。
stmt:
theorem contraction_of_deriv_bound (f : X → X) (f' : X → X →L[ℝ] X) (C : ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt f (f' x) x) (hbound : ∀ x, ‖f' x‖ ≤ C) :
    ∀ a b, ‖f a - f b‖ ≤ C * ‖a - b‖
proof:
by
  intro a b
  exact Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasFDerivWithin_le
    (fun x _ => (hf x).hasFDerivWithinAt) (fun x _ => hbound x) convex_univ
    (Set.mem_univ a) (Set.mem_univ b)

name: contraction_derivative_fixed_point_existsUnique
doc: **导数版本的不动点存在唯一性**：`∀x, ‖f' x‖ ≤ C < 1` 且空间完备 ⟹ 存在唯一不动点。
stmt:
theorem contraction_derivative_fixed_point_existsUnique [CompleteSpace X] (f : X → X)
    (f' : X → X →L[ℝ] X) {C : ℝ} (hC0 : 0 ≤ C) (hC1 : C < 1)
    (hf : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt f (f' x) x) (hbound : ∀ x, ‖f' x‖ ≤ C) :
    ∃! p : X, f p = p
proof: contraction_fixed_point_existsUnique hC0 hC1 f (contraction_of_deriv_bound f f' C hf hbound)

name: euclidean_derivative_fixed_point_existsUnique
doc:
**有限维 `EuclideanSpace` 上的导数版本**（`‖f'‖ < 1`）：
完备性由 mathlib 现成的 `FiniteDimensional.complete` 提供
（`EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)` 是有限维的），因此「有限维完备」不是本文件的新假设，
而是直接调用 mathlib。
stmt:
theorem euclidean_derivative_fixed_point_existsUnique (n : ℕ)
    (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (f' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ]
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    {C : ℝ} (hC0 : 0 ≤ C) (hC1 : C < 1)
    (hf : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt f (f' x) x) (hbound : ∀ x, ‖f' x‖ ≤ C) :
    ∃! p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), f p = p
proof:
by
  haveI : CompleteSpace (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) := FiniteDimensional.complete ℝ _
  exact contraction_derivative_fixed_point_existsUnique f f' hC0 hC1 hf hbound

name: euclidean_affine_fixed_point_existsUnique
doc: **有限维 `EuclideanSpace` 上的仿射版本**：`‖T‖ < 1` ⟹ `∃!p, T p + b = p`。
stmt:
theorem euclidean_affine_fixed_point_existsUnique (n : ℕ)
    (T : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (hT : ‖T‖ < 1) :
    ∃! p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), T p + b = p
proof:
by
  haveI : CompleteSpace (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) := FiniteDimensional.complete ℝ _
  exact affine_fixed_point_existsUnique T b hT

name: rnn_step_lipschitz
stmt:
lemma rnn_step_lipschitz (φ : X → X) (W U : X →L[ℝ] X) (Lφ : ℝ)
    (hφ : ∀ a b, ‖φ a - φ b‖ ≤ Lφ * ‖a - b‖) (hLφ : 0 ≤ Lφ) (h g x : X) :
    ‖RNNStep φ W U h x - RNNStep φ W U g x‖ ≤ (Lφ * ‖W‖) * ‖h - g‖
proof:
by
  have hsub : (W h + U x) - (W g + U x) = W (h - g) := by
    rw [show (W h + U x) - (W g + U x) = W h - W g by abel, map_sub]
  calc
    ‖RNNStep φ W U h x - RNNStep φ W U g x‖
        = ‖φ (W h + U x) - φ (W g + U x)‖ := by rfl
    _ ≤ Lφ * ‖(W h + U x) - (W g + U x)‖ := hφ _ _
    _ = Lφ * ‖W (h - g)‖ := by rw [hsub]
    _ ≤ Lφ * (‖W‖ * ‖h - g‖) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (W.le_opNorm (h - g)) hLφ
    _ = (Lφ * ‖W‖) * ‖h - g‖ := by ring

name: rnn_step_input_lipschitz
stmt:
lemma rnn_step_input_lipschitz (φ : X → X) (W U : X →L[ℝ] X) (Lφ Lu : ℝ)
    (hφ : ∀ a b, ‖φ a - φ b‖ ≤ Lφ * ‖a - b‖) (hLφ : 0 ≤ Lφ) (_hLu : 0 ≤ Lu)
    (hU : ∀ x, ‖U x‖ ≤ Lu * ‖x‖) (h g x y : X) :
    ‖RNNStep φ W U h x - RNNStep φ W U g y‖
      ≤ (Lφ * ‖W‖) * ‖h - g‖ + (Lφ * Lu) * ‖x - y‖
proof:
by
  have hsub : (W h + U x) - (W g + U y) = W (h - g) + U (x - y) := by
    rw [map_sub, map_sub]
    abel
  have hUxy : ‖U (x - y)‖ ≤ Lu * ‖x - y‖ := hU (x - y)
  have hWxy : ‖W (h - g)‖ ≤ ‖W‖ * ‖h - g‖ := W.le_opNorm (h - g)
  calc
    ‖RNNStep φ W U h x - RNNStep φ W U g y‖
        = ‖φ (W h + U x) - φ (W g + U y)‖ := by rfl
    _ ≤ Lφ * ‖(W h + U x) - (W g + U y)‖ := hφ _ _
    _ = Lφ * ‖W (h - g) + U (x - y)‖ := by rw [hsub]
    _ ≤ Lφ * (‖W (h - g)‖ + ‖U (x - y)‖) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_add_le _ _) hLφ
    _ ≤ Lφ * (‖W‖ * ‖h - g‖ + Lu * ‖x - y‖) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add hWxy hUxy) hLφ
    _ = (Lφ * ‖W‖) * ‖h - g‖ + (Lφ * Lu) * ‖x - y‖ := by ring

name: geom_sum_range_succ
stmt:
lemma geom_sum_range_succ (ρ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ i in Finset.range (n + 1), ρ ^ i) = 1 + ρ * (∑ i in Finset.range n, ρ ^ i)
proof:
by
  have hsum : (∑ i in Finset.range n, ρ ^ (i + 1)) = ∑ i in Finset.range n, ρ * ρ ^ i := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [pow_succ]
    ring
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ', Finset.mul_sum, hsum]
  ring

name: geometric_error_decay
stmt:
lemma geometric_error_decay (ρ c E δ : ℝ) (hρ0 : 0 ≤ ρ) (e : ℕ → ℝ)
    (he0 : e 0 ≤ E) (hstep : ∀ n, e (n + 1) ≤ ρ * e n + c * δ) :
    ∀ n, e n ≤ ρ ^ n * E + (∑ i in Finset.range n, ρ ^ i) * (c * δ)
proof:
by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using he0
  | succ n ih =>
      calc
        e (n + 1) ≤ ρ * e n + c * δ := hstep n
        _ ≤ ρ * (ρ ^ n * E + (∑ i in Finset.range n, ρ ^ i) * (c * δ)) + c * δ :=
              add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih hρ0) le_rfl
        _ = ρ ^ (n + 1) * E
              + (∑ i in Finset.range (n + 1), ρ ^ i) * (c * δ) := by
              rw [geom_sum_range_succ ρ n, pow_succ]
              ring

name: rnn_input_error_bound
stmt:
theorem rnn_input_error_bound (φ : X → X) (W U : X →L[ℝ] X) (Lφ Lu δ : ℝ)
    (hφ : ∀ a b, ‖φ a - φ b‖ ≤ Lφ * ‖a - b‖) (hLφ : 0 ≤ Lφ) (hLu : 0 ≤ Lu)
    (hU : ∀ x, ‖U x‖ ≤ Lu * ‖x‖)
    (h0 g0 : X) (xs ys : ℕ → X) (n : ℕ)
    (hδ : ∀ k, ‖xs k - ys k‖ ≤ δ) :
    ‖rnnState φ W U h0 xs n - rnnState φ W U g0 ys n‖
      ≤ (Lφ * ‖W‖) ^ n * ‖h0 - g0‖
        + (∑ i in Finset.range n, (Lφ * ‖W‖) ^ i) * ((Lφ * Lu) * δ)
proof:
by
  have hρ0 : 0 ≤ Lφ * ‖W‖ := mul_nonneg hLφ (norm_nonneg W)
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ Lφ * Lu := mul_nonneg hLφ hLu
  have hstep : ∀ k, ‖rnnState φ W U h0 xs (k + 1) - rnnState φ W U g0 ys (k + 1)‖
      ≤ (Lφ * ‖W‖) * ‖rnnState φ W U h0 xs k - rnnState φ W U g0 ys k‖
        + (Lφ * Lu) * δ := by
    intro k
    have hunfold : rnnState φ W U h0 xs (k + 1)
        = RNNStep φ W U (rnnState φ W U h0 xs k) (xs k) := by simp [rnnState]
    have hunfold' : rnnState φ W U g0 ys (k + 1)
        = RNNStep φ W U (rnnState φ W U g0 ys k) (ys k) := by simp [rnnState]
    have hk := rnn_step_input_lipschitz φ W U Lφ Lu hφ hLφ hLu hU
      (rnnState φ W U h0 xs k) (rnnState φ W U g0 ys k) (xs k) (ys k)
    have hk' : ‖rnnState φ W U h0 xs (k + 1) - rnnState φ W U g0 ys (k + 1)‖
        ≤ (Lφ * ‖W‖) * ‖rnnState φ W U h0 xs k - rnnState φ W U g0 ys k‖
          + (Lφ * Lu) * ‖xs k - ys k‖ := by rw [hunfold, hunfold']; exact hk
    exact hk'.trans (add_le_add le_rfl (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hδ k) hc0))
  have hmain := geometric_error_decay (Lφ * ‖W‖) (Lφ * Lu) ‖h0 - g0‖ δ hρ0
    (fun k => ‖rnnState φ W U h0 xs k - rnnState φ W U g0 ys k‖)
    (by simp [rnnState]) hstep
  exact hmain n

name: rnnState_eq_of_eq_prefix
stmt:
lemma rnnState_eq_of_eq_prefix (φ : X → X) (W U : X →L[ℝ] X) (h0 g0 : X)
    (xs ys : ℕ → X) :
    ∀ k, h0 = g0 → (∀ j, j < k → xs j = ys j) →
      rnnState φ W U h0 xs k = rnnState φ W U g0 ys k
proof:
by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro heq _; simpa [rnnState] using heq
  | succ k ih =>
      intro heq hxs
      have hunfold : rnnState φ W U h0 xs (k + 1)
          = RNNStep φ W U (rnnState φ W U h0 xs k) (xs k) := by simp [rnnState]
      have hunfold' : rnnState φ W U g0 ys (k + 1)
          = RNNStep φ W U (rnnState φ W U g0 ys k) (ys k) := by simp [rnnState]
      rw [hunfold, hunfold', ih heq (fun j hj => hxs j (by omega)), hxs k (by omega)]

name: rnn_forget_bound
stmt:
theorem rnn_forget_bound (φ : X → X) (W U : X →L[ℝ] X) (Lφ Lu δ : ℝ)
    (hφ : ∀ a b, ‖φ a - φ b‖ ≤ Lφ * ‖a - b‖) (hLφ : 0 ≤ Lφ) (hLu : 0 ≤ Lu)
    (hU : ∀ x, ‖U x‖ ≤ Lu * ‖x‖)
    (h0 : X) (xs ys : ℕ → X) (k m : ℕ)
    (hk : ‖xs k - ys k‖ ≤ δ)
    (hxs : ∀ j, j ≠ k → xs j = ys j) :
    ‖rnnState φ W U h0 xs (k + 1 + m) - rnnState φ W U h0 ys (k + 1 + m)‖
      ≤ (Lφ * ‖W‖) ^ m * ((Lφ * Lu) * δ)
proof:
by
  have hρ0 : 0 ≤ Lφ * ‖W‖ := mul_nonneg hLφ (norm_nonneg W)
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ Lφ * Lu := mul_nonneg hLφ hLu
  have hsame : rnnState φ W U h0 xs k = rnnState φ W U h0 ys k :=
    rnnState_eq_of_eq_prefix φ W U h0 h0 xs ys k rfl (fun j hj => hxs j (by omega))
                                 
  have hE : ‖rnnState φ W U h0 xs (k + 1) - rnnState φ W U h0 ys (k + 1)‖
      ≤ (Lφ * Lu) * δ := by
    have hunfold : rnnState φ W U h0 xs (k + 1)
        = RNNStep φ W U (rnnState φ W U h0 xs k) (xs k) := by simp [rnnState]
    have hunfold' : rnnState φ W U h0 ys (k + 1)
        = RNNStep φ W U (rnnState φ W U h0 ys k) (ys k) := by simp [rnnState]
    have hstep := rnn_step_input_lipschitz φ W U Lφ Lu hφ hLφ hLu hU
      (rnnState φ W U h0 xs k) (rnnState φ W U h0 ys k) (xs k) (ys k)
    rw [hunfold, hunfold']
    calc
      ‖RNNStep φ W U (rnnState φ W U h0 xs k) (xs k)
          - RNNStep φ W U (rnnState φ W U h0 ys k) (ys k)‖
          ≤ (Lφ * ‖W‖) * ‖rnnState φ W U h0 xs k - rnnState φ W U h0 ys k‖
              + (Lφ * Lu) * ‖xs k - ys k‖ := hstep
      _ = (Lφ * Lu) * ‖xs k - ys k‖ := by simp [hsame]
      _ ≤ (Lφ * Lu) * δ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hk hc0
                         
  have hdecay : ∀ m, ‖rnnState φ W U h0 xs (k + 1 + m) - rnnState φ W U h0 ys (k + 1 + m)‖
      ≤ (Lφ * ‖W‖) ^ m * ((Lφ * Lu) * δ) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => simpa using hE
    | succ m ih =>
        have hidx : k + 1 + (m + 1) = k + 1 + m + 1 := by omega
        have h

doc: 辅助：`f p = p` ⟹ `iterate f n p = p`（不动点迭代仍不动）。
stmt:
lemma iterate_fixed_point (f : Y → Y) (p : Y) (hp : f p = p) :
    ∀ n, iterate f n p = p
proof:
by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [iterate]
  | succ n ih =>
      show iterate f n (f p) = p

name: iterate_lipschitz
doc: 辅助：Lipschitz 映射的迭代是 Lⁿ-Lipschitz（`iterate_step_swap`）。
stmt:
lemma iterate_lipschitz (f : Y → Y) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hf : ∀ a b, ‖f a - f b‖ ≤ L * ‖a - b‖) :
    ∀ n a b, ‖iterate f n a - iterate f n b‖ ≤ L ^ n * ‖a - b‖
proof:
by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro a b; simp [iterate]
  | succ n ih =>
      intro a b
      have hswap : iterate f n (f a) = f (iterate f n a) := iterate_step_swap f n a
      have hswap' : iterate f n (f b) = f (iterate f n b) := iterate_step_swap f n b
      have hunfold : iterate f (n + 1) a = iterate f n (f a) := by simp [iterate]
      have hunfold' : iterate f (n + 1) b = iterate f n (f b) := by simp [iterate]
      rw [hunfold, hunfold', hswap, hswap']
      calc
        ‖f (iterate f n a) - f (iterate f n b)‖
            ≤ L * ‖iterate f n a - iterate f n b‖ := hf _ _
        _ ≤ L * (L ^ n * ‖a - b‖) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ih a b) hL
        _ = L ^ (n + 1) * ‖a - b‖ := by ring

name: loop_converges_to_fixed_point
doc: 迭代对不动点的几何收敛率 `‖Tⁿ h₀ − p‖ ≤ ρⁿ·‖h₀ − p‖`（文件头定理链第 7 条）。
stmt:
theorem loop_converges_to_fixed_point (φ : Y → Y) (W U : Y →L[ℝ] Y) (Lφ : ℝ)
    (hφ : ∀ a b, ‖φ a - φ b‖ ≤ Lφ * ‖a - b‖) (hLφ : 0 ≤ Lφ) (x : Y)
    (h0 p : Y) (hp : loopStepMap φ W U x p = p) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖iterate (loopStepMap φ W U x) n h0 - p‖
      ≤ (Lφ * ‖W‖) ^ n * ‖h0 - p‖
proof:
by
  have hρ0 : 0 ≤ Lφ * ‖W‖ := mul_nonneg hLφ (norm_nonneg W)
  have hlip : ∀ a b, ‖loopStepMap φ W U x a - loopStepMap φ W U x b‖ ≤ (Lφ * ‖W‖) * ‖a - b‖ :=
    loop_model_contraction φ W U Lφ hφ hLφ x
  have hiter := iterate_lipschitz (loopStepMap φ W U x) (Lφ * ‖W‖) hρ0 hlip n h0 p
  have hfix : iterate (loopStepMap φ W U x) n p = p := iterate_fixed_point _ p hp n
  rw [hfix] at hiter
  exact hiter

name: loop_iterate_convergence
doc: ρ < 1 ⟹ 两条迭代轨迹最终 ε-接近（接 `contraction_converges`；文件头定理链第 8 条）。
stmt:
theorem loop_iterate_convergence (φ : Y → Y) (W U : Y →L[ℝ] Y) (Lφ : ℝ)
    (hφ : ∀ a b, ‖φ a - φ b‖ ≤ Lφ * ‖a - b‖) (hLφ : 0 ≤ Lφ)
    (hρ0 : 0 ≤ Lφ * ‖W‖) (hρ1 : Lφ * ‖W‖ < 1) (x h0 g0 : Y) :
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
      ∃ n : ℕ, ‖iterate (loopStepMap φ W U x) n h0
        - iterate (loopStepMap φ W U x) n g0‖ < ε
proof:
by
  have hlip : ∀ a b,
      ‖loopStepMap φ W U x a - loopStepMap φ W U x b‖ ≤ (Lφ * ‖W‖) * ‖a - b‖ :=
    loop_model_contraction φ W U Lφ hφ hLφ x
  refine contraction_converges (Lφ * ‖W‖) hρ0 hρ1 ?_ ?_
  · intro n
    have hswap : iterate (loopStepMap φ W U x) n (loopStepMap φ W U x h0)
        = loopStepMap φ W U x (iterate (loopStepMap φ W U x) n h0) :=
      iterate_step_swap _ n h0
    have hswap' : iterate (loopStepMap φ W U x) n (loopStepMap φ W U x g0)
        = loopStepMap φ W U x (iterate (loopStepMap φ W U x) n g0) :=
      iterate_step_swap _ n g0
    have hunfold : iterate (loopStepMap φ W U x) (n + 1) h0
        = iterate (loopStepMap φ W U x) n (loopStepMap φ W U x h0) := by simp [iterate]
    have hunfold' : iterate (loopStepMap φ W U x) (n + 1) g0
        = iterate (loopStepMap φ W U x) n (loopStepMap φ W U x g0) := by simp [iterate]
    rw [hunfold, hunfold', hswap, hswap']
    exact hlip _ _
  · intro n
    exact norm_nonneg _

end IterateLink

lemma matvecE_add (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :

      intro j hj

name: row_cs_bound
doc:
行 Cauchy-Schwarz：内积 ⟪Aᵢ·, x⟫ = Σⱼ Aᵢⱼ xⱼ 满足
(Σⱼ Aᵢⱼ xⱼ)² ≤ (Σⱼ Aᵢⱼ²)·(Σⱼ xⱼ²)。
stmt:
lemma row_cs_bound (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (i : Fin m) :
    (∑ j : Fin n, A i j * x j) ^ 2 ≤ (∑ j : Fin n, (A i j) ^ 2) * (∑ j : Fin n, (x j) ^ 2)
proof:
by
  let u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) := fun j : Fin n => A i j
  have hcs := abs_real_inner_le_norm u x
  have hsq : (inner u x) ^ 2 ≤ ‖u‖ ^ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
    calc
      (inner u x) ^ 2 = |(inner u x)| ^ 2 := by rw [sq_abs]
      _ ≤ (‖u‖ * ‖x‖) ^ 2 := by
        have hb : 0 ≤ ‖u‖ * ‖x‖ := mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)
        exact sq_le_sq.mpr (by simpa [abs_of_nonneg hb] using hcs)
      _ = ‖u‖ ^ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by ring
  rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct] at hsq
  rw [euclid_norm_sq_eq, euclid_norm_sq_eq] at hsq
  simpa [Matrix.dotProduct, u] using hsq

name: frobenius_le_opNorm_sqrt
doc: 诚实反向界：‖A‖_F ≤ √n·‖A‖_op（n = 列数；标准形式为 √n，未强求 √(m·n)）。
stmt:
theorem frobenius_le_opNorm_sqrt (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    frobeniusNorm A ≤ Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) * ‖matCLME A‖
proof:
by
  have hsq : (frobeniusNorm A) ^ 2 ≤ (n : ℝ) * ‖matCLME A‖ ^ 2 := by
    calc
      (frobeniusNorm A) ^ 2 = ∑ j : Fin n, ‖matvecE A (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2 :=
        frobenius_sq_eq_sum_col A
      _ ≤ ∑ j : Fin n, ‖matCLME A‖ ^ 2 := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro j hj
        have hle := col_norm_le_opNorm A j
        exact sq_le_sq.mpr (by
          rw [abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _), abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)]
          exact hle)
      _ = (Fintype.card (Fin n)) * ‖matCLME A‖ ^ 2 := by
        simp
      _ = (n : ℝ) * ‖matCLME A‖ ^ 2 := by
        simp [Fintype.card_fin]
  have hsqrt : (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) * ‖matCLME A‖) ^ 2 = (n : ℝ) * ‖matCLME A‖ ^ 2 := by
    have hn : 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.zero_le n)
    rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hn]
  have hsq' : (frobeniusNorm A) ^ 2 ≤ (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) * ‖matCLME A‖) ^ 2 := by
    rwa [hsqrt]
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) * ‖matCLME A‖ :=
    mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)
  have habs : |frobeniusNorm A| ≤ |Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) * ‖matCLME A‖| := (sq_le_sq.mp hsq')
  simpa [abs_of_nonneg (frobeniusNorm_nonneg A), abs_of_nonneg hnonneg] using habs

name: sigmoid_monotone
stmt: theorem sigmoid_monotone (x y : ℝ) (h : x ≤ y) : sigmoid x ≤ sigmoid y
proof:
by
  unfold sigmoid
                                        
  have hne : Real.exp (-y) ≤ Real.exp (-x) := by
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
                               
  have hd1 : 0 < 1 + Real.exp (-x) := by positivity
  have hd2 : 0 < 1 + Real.exp (-y) := by positivity
  have hden : 1 + Real.exp (-y) ≤ 1 + Real.exp (-x) := by linarith
                                  
  have hinv : (1 + Real.exp (-x))⁻¹ ≤ (1 + Real.exp (-y))⁻¹ :=
    (inv_le_inv₀ hd1 hd2).mpr hden
          
  calc
    1 / (1 + Real.exp (-x)) = (1 + Real.exp (-x))⁻¹ := by rw [div_eq_mul_inv]; ring
    _ ≤ (1 + Real.exp (-y))⁻¹ := hinv
    _ = 1 / (1 + Real.exp (-y)) := by rw [div_eq_mul_inv]; ring

name: drop_lower_bound
doc: * **下界**：Sum load - Sum cap <= droppedCount。
stmt:
theorem drop_lower_bound (load capacity : iota → Nat) :
    (∑ e, load e) - (∑ e, capacity e) ≤ droppedCount load capacity
proof:
by
  unfold droppedCount droppedAt
                                              
                                     
  have key : ∀ e : iota, load e - capacity e ≤ max 0 (load e - capacity e) := by
    intro e; omega
                                                         
  have hsub : (∑ e, (load e - capacity e)) ≤ ∑ e, max 0 (load e - capacity e) :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum fun e _ => key e
                                                                     
  have hsplit : (∑ e, load e) - (∑ e, capacity e) ≤ ∑ e, (load e - capacity e) := by
    have : ∑ e, (load e - capacity e) + ∑ e, capacity e ≥ ∑ e, load e := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun e _ => by omega
    omega
  omega

name: routeLoad_sum_eq_card_mul
doc: 每个 token 恰好选 `k` 个专家时，**总扇入 = k * |T|**：双重计数恒等式。
stmt:
theorem routeLoad_sum_eq_card_mul (T : Finset tau) (R : tau -> Finset iota) (k : Nat)
    (hcard : ∀ t ∈ T, (R t).card = k) :
    (∑ e, routeLoad T R e) = k * T.card
proof:
by
  classical
  have hswap : (∑ e, routeLoad T R e) = ∑ t in T, (R t).card := by
    conv_lhs => arg 2; intro e; rw [routeLoad, Finset.card_eq_sum_ones, Finset.sum_filter]
    rw [show (∑ e : iota, ∑ a ∈ T, (if e ∈ R a then 1 else 0))
          = ∑ e ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset iota), ∑ a ∈ T, (if e ∈ R a then 1 else 0) by simp]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun t _ => ?_)
    rw [Finset.sum_boole (fun e => e ∈ R t) Finset.univ]
    simp
  rw [hswap, Finset.sum_congr rfl hcard, Finset.sum_const, smul_eq_mul, Nat.mul_comm]

name: topk_route_capacity_exceeded
doc: * **top-k 路由 + 容量不足 => 必丢弃**。
stmt:
theorem topk_route_capacity_exceeded (T : Finset tau) (R : tau -> Finset iota)
    (capacity : iota -> Nat) (k : Nat) [Nonempty iota]
    (hcard : ∀ t ∈ T, (R t).card = k)
    (hover : (∑ e, capacity e) < k * T.card) :
    0 < routeDropped T R capacity
proof:
by
  apply drop_of_total_exceeds_capacity
  rw [routeLoad_sum_eq_card_mul T R k hcard]
  exact hover

    ∃ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s ∧ modReLU b z = (s : ℂ) * z
proof:
by
  refine ⟨relu (Complex.abs z + b) / Complex.abs z, modReLU_gain_nonneg b z, ?_⟩
  exact modReLU_phase_preserved b z hz

name: relu_le_abs
stmt: lemma relu_le_abs (x : ℝ) : relu x ≤ |x|
proof:
by
  unfold relu
  exact max_le (le_abs_self x) (abs_nonneg x)

name: modReLU_bounded
stmt: theorem modReLU_bounded (b : ℝ) (z : ℂ) : Complex.abs (modReLU b z) ≤ Complex.abs z + |b|
proof:
by
  by_cases hz : z = 0
  · subst hz
    rw [modReLU_zero b]
    rw [← Complex.norm_eq_abs (0 : ℂ)]
    simp
  · rw [modReLU_magnitude b z hz]
    calc
      relu (Complex.abs z + b) ≤ |Complex.abs z + b| := relu_le_abs _
      _ ≤ |Complex.abs z| + |b| := abs_add _ _
      _ = Complex.abs z + |b| := by rw [abs_of_nonneg (Complex.abs.nonneg z)]

name: modReLU_one_half
doc: 具体值：`modReLU 1 (1/2) = 3/2`（实数意义下，`b = 1 > 0`）。
stmt:
theorem modReLU_one_half :
    modReLU 1 (((1 / 2 : ℝ)) : ℂ) = (((3 / 2 : ℝ)) : ℂ)
proof:
by
  have hz : (((1 / 2 : ℝ)) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by norm_num
  rw [modReLU_phase_preserved 1 _ hz]
  have habs : Complex.abs ((((1 / 2 : ℝ)) : ℂ)) = (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
    rw [Complex.abs_ofReal]
    norm_num
  have hr : relu (Complex.abs ((((1 / 2 : ℝ)) : ℂ)) + 1) = (3 / 2 : ℝ) := by
    rw [habs]
    unfold relu
    norm_num
  rw [hr, habs]
  norm_num

name: modReLU_counterexample
stmt:
theorem modReLU_counterexample :
    Complex.abs (modReLU 1 0 - modReLU 1 (((1 / 2 : ℝ)) : ℂ)) = 3 / 2 ∧
    Complex.abs ((0 : ℂ) - (((1 / 2 : ℝ)) : ℂ)) = 1 / 2
proof:
by
  constructor
  · rw [modReLU_zero, zero_sub, modReLU_one_half]
    rw [← Complex.ofReal_neg, Complex.abs_ofReal]
    norm_num
  · rw [show (0 : ℂ) - (((1 / 2 : ℝ)) : ℂ) = (((-(1 / 2) : ℝ)) : ℂ) by norm_num]
    rw [Complex.abs_ofReal]
    norm_num
